headline: This comfy gaming headset that can play audio from two sources is $25
summary: The EPOS H3 Hybrid gaming headset is now just $24.99 at Woot, a 75% discount. This capable wired headset offers impressive features, including dual audio source support. It's a budget-friendly option, originally priced at $99.99.

headline: Logitech will pull a Nintendo — only European mice will come with replaceable batteries
summary: Logitech plans to offer user-replaceable batteries only in European mice, mirroring Nintendo's recent move for the Switch 2. This decision is in response to a new European law requiring user-replaceable batteries by February 2027. The company is not extending this feature to other global markets.

headline: Apple won’t turn on any ‘restricted mode’ for missed lease payments
summary: Apple confirms it will not limit device capabilities for users who miss payments on its new Upgrade program. An Apple spokesperson stated there will be no 'restricted mode' or functionality limitations due to payment defaults. This clarifies concerns regarding the terms of their device leasing initiative.

headline: New Yorkers will soon need to verify their age to access algorithmic feeds
summary: New Yorkers must soon verify their age to access algorithmic social media feeds like Instagram or TikTok. The age verification will also be required to receive notifications after midnight. This is part of the final rules implementing the SAFE for Kids Act.

headline: The 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Is One of the Best PC Gaming Controllers Under $50, and It's Less Than Half That Price
summary: The 8BitDo Ultimate 2C controller is now available for under $25, making it less than half its original price. It's highly rated as one of the best PC gaming controllers available for under $50. The versatile controller is compatible with Windows PC, Android, and Steam Deck.

headline: Today’s Best Deals: Ghost of Tsushima, Stranger Things Deluxe 4K UHD, and Resident Evil Requiem
summary: Discover today's top deals on popular gaming titles, including Ghost of Tsushima and Resident Evil Requiem. Find discounts on the Stranger Things Deluxe 4K UHD set. Don't miss out on savings for various PS5 discs and LEGO sets.

headline: Get All of the Dungeon Crawler Carl Books for $21 With This Amazon Kindle Deal
summary: All books in the popular Dungeon Crawler Carl series are now available for just $21 on Amazon Kindle. This limited-time Amazon deal offers a significant discount on the entire collection. Dive into the acclaimed sci-fi/fantasy saga at an unmissable price.

headline: Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 First Look Teases Return of Quinn, New Kills, and More
summary: The first official look at Dexter: Resurrection Season 2 has been released, hinting at plot developments. The preview teases the return of Quinn and promises new kills, keeping fans on edge. It appears Dexter will once again confront elements from his past.

headline: The moment Tuesday's powerful earthquake hit Japan
summary: A powerful earthquake struck Japan's Kyushu island on July 28, causing significant tremors. Video footage has emerged, capturing the moment of impact across various affected regional locations. The clips provide a visual account of Tuesday's strong seismic event.

headline: Some parents on benefits to get up to £4,500 for child starting apprenticeship
summary: Parents on benefits could receive up to £4,500 as an incentive if their child starts an apprenticeship. The new scheme aims to encourage young people into vocational training and address existing disincentives. This financial support is designed to boost apprenticeship uptake among eligible families.

headline: Uefa reacts with fury to Infantino World Cup plan
summary: UEFA has reacted furiously to new proposals from FIFA President Gianni Infantino regarding the World Cup. Infantino's plan involves seeking private investment for FIFA's competitions, including the prestigious World Cup. European football's governing body strongly opposes this controversial financial strategy.

headline: Wildfires in south-west France flare up as region braces for new 40C heatwave
summary: Wildfires are flaring up again in south-west France, particularly in the Gironde region. Firefighters are bracing for a sharp rise in temperatures, with a new heatwave expected to reach 40C on Wednesday. The intense heat is predicted to complicate efforts to contain the ongoing blazes.
